identity.name: Paradex Henry Hub Natural Gas Perp

about.description: NG is a commodity perpetual on Paradex tracking Henry Hub Natural Gas spot pricing. Paradex is a permissionless perp and options DEX operating on its own Starknet-based appchain (Paradex Chain / DimeVM), with zero-fee trading, unified cross-margin in USDC, and ZK-encrypted account privacy. The market is cash-settled in USDC.
